candidate.title: scAba-Seq
candidate.scope: The Illumina poster implementation-level schematic in the middle row labelled scAba-Seq: detection of 5hmC in single-cell DNA by glucosylation, AbaSI digestion, ligation of cell-barcoded Illumina/T7 constructs, pooling, and a broad T7 amplification block ending in DNA. The neighboring snmC-Seq and sci-MET rows are separate workflows, not alternatives or members of this card. The diagram contains no named scAba-Seq alternative branch. This is a schematic architecture, not a complete laboratory protocol or a claim that all family implementations share every preparation detail.
